content: Yoga is the settling of the mind into silence. When the mind is settled, you are established in your essential nature.
author: Patanjali
explanation:
Patanjali opens the Yoga Sutras with the ultimate definition of yoga: Yogas Chitta Vritti Nirodha—the cessation of the turbulent whirlpools of thought. When a lake is agitated by relentless wind and waves, the sunlight is scattered and the lakebed is invisible. When the water becomes utterly still, the crystalline depths and the reflection of the sky are revealed with breathtaking clarity.

When mental chatter subsides, you stop confusing yourself with fleeting moods and rest in your true, indestructible nature.
practicalInsight: Practice deliberate mental stillness today: sit quietly for five minutes, watching your thoughts arise and dissolve like passing clouds without grabbing onto them.
reflectionPrompt: How often do you mistake the temporary storm on the surface of your mind for who you truly are?
